svg.text: SparkBox — anatomy of a JSON form dialog (JSONFormDialog)
A dialog is an HTML <template> rendered once with the page, cloned by JavaScript, and filled through JSON requests to a responder — render first, submit after.
Component selector from class / name / field / id
JSONDialog new JSONRequest(), responder from the element attribute
The responder must exist for the request
created by the page or its content (constructor of a template content,
or early: RequestResponder::EarlyProcessing() = true — Module creates it
by name before the page (help, uploads, translators, section chooser …)
JSON requests go to the current page URL (window.location) — the same page
that showed the dialog builds the same responders again
Module::Response(): after authorization — early responder, or after page create
isJSONRequest → Get(responder name) → accept(): parse parameters (prodID …)
FormRenderer without submit line → render() echoes the FORM
contents = output buffer · status OK → json_encode → exit
fatal error → the buffer callback returns {status: Error, message}
inline <script> re-created (innerHTML does not run them)
components listening initialise the new inputs
form = element FORM; name = form name
resp->message + render the form again with its errors → contents
(the form with its errors, same dialog)
no contents → GTM event (SparkEvent GTM_EVENT) if gtm,
Same request path without a dialog:
JSONComponent.js → responder 'render' → one root node appended
PHP: class X extends JSONFormResponder { createForm(); onProcessSuccess() }
created by the page — or EarlyProcessing() true if it needs nothing
JS: new JSONFormDialog(); setResponder('X'); setTitle(); show()
the template is on the page once any JSONFormDialog is created
(StorePageBase / admin page create one for this)
JS: sparkfront/js (SparkObject, Component, TemplateComponent, TemplateFactory, JSONRequest, dialogs/) · PHP: dialogs/, responders/json/, pages/HTMLBody.php
